top_signals.title: US Stocks ‘Directionless’ as Chipmaker Earnings, CPI to Set Pace
top_signals.summary: US stocks were looking for direction after a strong earnings week as investors continue to navigate the uncertain path of interest rates and war in Iran. The market is gearing up for the final stretch of corporate earnings, with chipmakers set to provide confirmation for the long-winded debate over valuations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: H100 becomes Europe’s No. 2 Bitcoin treasury after 2,455 BTC deal
top_signals.summary: Sweden’s H100 more than tripled its Bitcoin holdings to 3,506 BTC after completing an acquisition involving 2,455 BTC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin puts privacy and quantum resistance front and center in Ethereum’s latest roadmap
top_signals.summary: Buterin previously said the upgrades included in Lean Ethereum will form the protocol's “third major iteration.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
